PullRequest.Title: ci: give every Windows CI job the 70 minute timeout
PullRequest.Body:

Refs microsoft/vscode-engineering#2896. Follow-up to #340808.

#340808 raised Windows **Unit Tests** to 70 minutes. **Browser & Remote** and **Integration (Electron)** also time out at 50 minutes when the `node_modules` cache misses, because the clean install takes about 14–16 minutes on Windows. This PR gives every Windows CI job 70 minutes. The timeout is only an upper bound, so runs with a warm cache don't get slower.

Main CI, Sep 30–Oct 9 (247 builds, 35 with a cold Windows cache):

| Windows job | Timeout before | Cold-cache timeouts at 50m | Cold runs within 3 min of 50 | Slowest cold run |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Unit Tests | 70 (#340808) | 13 | 11 | 53.1m |
| **Browser & Remote** | **50** | **3** (481525, 481690, 482239) | 7 (482906: 47.3m) | 50.9m |
| **Integration (Electron)** | **50** | **1** (481097) | 6 (482462: 49.0m) | 50.9m |
| Smoke (Electron) | 70 | 0 | 4 | 53.7m |

Every timeout was on a cold cache. With a warm cache, no Windows job went above 36.2m.

## How to test

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `node --test build/lib/test/testCheckpointTemplates.test.ts build/lib/test/testCheckpoint.test.ts` | ✅ 30 passed (the #340808 template test is updated to expect an unconditional 70) |
| `eslint build/lib/test/testCheckpointTemplates.test.ts` | ✅ passed |

Scenarios.CriticalPath: Dependency setup, compilation, and tests remain unchanged; only the maximum job lifetime rises.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Four fixed jobs with partitioned test IDs.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Four parallel jobs before and after the change.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Warm cache extraction and cold cache npm installation are unchanged.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High; the diff changes only timeoutInMinutes and its test.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Hung jobs may occupy an agent longer, but remain bounded.
